headline: UK and EU sign major post-Brexit pact on food trade, carbon, and mobility
summary: British and European Union leaders signed three comprehensive agreements in Brussels covering food trade, carbon markets, and youth mobility, marking their largest bilateral package since the UK left the bloc.
why: Closer regulatory and market linkages between the European Union and the United Kingdom reduce non-tariff friction and support cross-border commercial flows.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: New trade agreements lower regulatory barriers on food trade and link environmental policies with the EU.
